Drexathon 2026 · Track 1

Fossil or fiction?

Boneify checks every sentence an AI writes against the original document, and shows the proof.

Nick & Anish · built on Nace Drex and NDI

AI summaries sound sure. Some of it is fiction.

WHAT THE AI WROTE

“The agreement runs for five years.”

WRONG

WHAT THE CONTRACT SAYS · §2.1, PAGE 1

“The initial term of this Agreement is three (3) years from the Effective Date.”

One wrong number in a contract summary can cost real money. Nobody has time to re-read the whole document.

Every sentence gets a verdict. With a receipt.

Correct

“The dashboard must be available at least 99.5% of each month, excluding announced maintenance.”

§1.2 · PAGE 1

Wrong

“Juniper Freight pays a monthly service fee of $18,500.”

§3.1 SAYS $12,500

Made up

“Either party may terminate for convenience on 30 days’ notice.”

→

Either party may terminate for cause if the other party materially breaches and does not cure the breach within 30 days after written notice.
